cost_centers_hint: Where a cost belongs — head office, marketing, transport — independent of branches. Pick one on expenses and journal entries.
name: Name
allocation_rules_hint: How a shared cost, such as head-office rent, is split across branches. Each change is a new version from a date, so past expenses keep their split.
total_must_be_100: The shares must add up to 100%.
new_version_hint: Leave empty to keep the split as it is. A version on an existing date replaces it.
allocation_rule_hint: Optional: split this expense across branches by a rule. Other branches' parts go through the Inter-branch Clearing account.
